notes.title: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Liberation now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/1e528742b48658ceb8e85b7b23c17eb2f2745f1f.jpg[/img]

[b][i]“Soldiers, Sailors, and Airmen of the Allied Expeditionary Force: you are about to embark upon the Great Crusade!”[/i][/b]

[h1]Release[/h1]
Community members! Today we proudly announce the release of Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Liberation! 
This DLC introduces the western front action in 1944, featuring the US faction, as well as German western front content.
A year and a half of working non- stop has resulted in our biggest DLC to date. We would like to thank everyone that supported us while we were developing this love baby, and now it’s time to release it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2447590/Call_to_Arms__Gates_of_Hell_Liberation/

[h2]Release the Kraken[/h2]
We’ve had a lot of positive feedback from the content creators we asked to showcase Liberation; they confirm the Western Front with its Bocages and other unique features make for a different feel to gameplay altogether. This is not the Eastern Front!
It’s not like we’ve actually released the Kraken but after you’ve tried it, you’ll probably agree that this is something quite different. It ought to be; the sheer number of maps, assets and models make for a package that is indeed a whole new front. It’s larger than its base game was, when it was released in 2021!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/19eaf43a2f25a0c902e968310dfa8defb9d433f2.jpg[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/19eaf43a2f25a0c902e968310dfa8defb9d433f2.jpg]HD Link[/url]

[h2]Units[/h2]
Yes, Liberation is our largest DLC package to date. This clearly shows, everywhere you look. Aside from all the editor assets and maps, we have a pretty long list of vehicles that come with Liberation. This would be obvious perhaps; the US army wasn’t short on variety!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/8adb77fc709c0c13d8f53c305750b9f34f4a6ae8.jpg[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/8adb77fc709c0c13d8f53c305750b9f34f4a6ae8.jpg]HD Link[/url]

The Liberation DLC contains:[list]
[*] 10 US single player missions, including 4 US skirmishes
[*] 6 German single player missions
[*] 150+ new US and German vehicles, cannon, ships, aircraft and tanks
[*] 50 new small arms
[*] 500+ new humanskins
[*] 20 new MP maps
[*] 25 new DCG (Conquest) maps
[*] 500+ new editor assets for the western European theater.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/8e279c279e02838036a96750e8adaf7b1dfd6f5d.png[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/8e279c279e02838036a96750e8adaf7b1dfd6f5d.png]HD Link[/url]

[h2]Novice players[/h2]
Call to Arms - Gates of Hell is a fairly realistic game. The sheer amount of units, game mechanics and gimmicks of the game can sometimes appear daunting to new players. Experience tells us that if you’re switching in from another RTT/ RTS game, you run into the learning curve unexpectedly, and you might be kicking yourself after a while for not having watched our [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLlqc9tFAAEUB1g5LE25DR1EF7_b24jP6R&si=KpwCVHEA9mh-m1AL]official tutorials on YouTube[/url], or not having played the in- game tutorial missions. So that definitely comes recommended. Alternatively one can dive into the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/manual/400750]Game manual[/url] or our [url=https://gatesofhell.fandom.com/wiki/Gates_of_Hell:_Ostfront_Wiki]FanWiki[/url] to get to know more about Call to Arms - Gates of Hell as well. And for those that prefer asking the community, there’s always our [url=https://discord.com/invite/zyRrWbDV2F]Discord server[/url]. 

[h2]Additions[/h2]
Some of the material will become available in the days after launch, and we will update the game for this in the coming week, or as soon as these items  become available. These are the briefing videos for the German singleplayer campaign and some parts of localisation.

[h2]Available worldwide now![/h2]
So without further ado, get “Liberation”, hit the beaches, and dive into the most immersive RTS depiction of the Western Front you have ever tried:

notes.title: Men of War II Multiplayer Tech Test - Jump Into the Action NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=SoFqHkgl93U;full][/previewyoutube]

Announced during the Future Games Show: Spring Showcase, the multiplayer tech test is the first time Men of War II is publicly playable and will run until Monday, March 27 (10 am PDT / 1 pm EDT / 5 pm UTC). The test features four multiplayer modes (of seven that will feature in the full game) and five varied maps, in addition to a set of nine single player tutorial missions that will take you from the basics through to advanced gameplay mechanics and systems.

[b]Enlisting in the tech test is simple; you just need to head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/]Men of War II Steam store page[/url] where you will have the option to ‘Request Access’ for a Men of War II Playtest - doing so will grant instant access to "Men of War II Playtest" in your Steam Library.[/b]

Once installed, you can battle it out in 1v1 up to 5v5 matchups via custom lobbies or PvP matchmaking. A lobby allows full control over the game mode, map selection and team sizes, as well as private, password protected lobbies. Matchmaking however will automatically group players by their real-world location and ranking based on their past games, and set them up in Front Line mode.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/

You will be able to choose from the 1st Infantry, 1st Tank or 1st Artillery battalion from the Soviet, German and U.S. armies, allowing you to try out over 80 units from the full game’s total roster of over 300. Each battalion features its own gameplay style and unique strategic opportunities resulting in a deeply rewarding experience that is easy to pick up, but difficult to master. Furthermore, the full game will feature individual battalion customisation and additional unit unlocks via in-game progression, expanding the level of control players have on the battlefield.

The tech test includes only a small sample of the content Men of War II will feature on release, but already proves the depth and variety of gameplay and dedication to historical accuracy that will make it the most immersive depiction of World War II battles in franchise history. It will feature 22 multiplayer maps when it launches later this year.

[b][h3]The four multiplayer modes available during the tech test are as follows:[/h3][/b]

[b]Combat[/b] - a classic Men of War mode featuring an all-out brawl between two teams. Victory goes to the team that can destroy the most enemy units, while keeping their own most valuable units alive. (Available on the Borovaya River and The Winter March maps).

[b]Assault Zones[/b] - opposing players go head-to-head to earn victory points by capturing and holding strategic points on the map. (Available on the Bazerville and Borovaya River maps).

[b]Front Line[/b] - a brand new, strategic mode, that sees teams using infantry to push their Front Line into enemy territory resulting in a tense tug-of-war style match-up in which teamwork is paramount. (Available on all five maps).

[b]Incursion[/b] - an asymmetric game mode utilising the Front Line mechanic, in which one team needs to capture a number of highlighted zones held by the opposing team. (Only available on The Coast map).

[b][h3]The following five maps in the tech test:[/h3][/b]

[b]Bazerville[/b] - a map with very little elevation, easy to navigate, open terrain, only sporadically peppered with lone buildings. Ideal for long-range fighting or exploiting weaknesses with fast-moving units.

[b]Borovaya River[/b]  - a very rugged map, featuring many hills and valleys in its terrain. The map is split in half by a large river, giving players many tactical options to try out and experiment with.

[b]Farmland[/b] - a complex map that at first glance seems deceptively simple due to its flat terrain with no elevation to speak of. This rural environment features many farmsteads and even greenhouse buildings, as well as deep ponds with narrow crossings, creating natural chokepoints for heavy vehicles.

[b]The Coast[/b] - while there is no naval combat present in Men of War II, in this map the sea plays a role, as it takes a significant part of the map, leaving a narrow strip of flat, level land to fight over.

[b]The Winter March[/b] - set in harsh winter conditions, this map combines rolling countryside terrain features with many village buildings showcasing the destructible environment elements of Men of War II and forcing players to utilise smart positioning to get a clear line of fire on their enemies.

[b]Men of War II will be available for PC in 2023. [/b]

notes.title: Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Talvisota - announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10379584/e1ec14f21b7142e3a4638c4b868f8c871e85adf7.png[/img]

Hello everyone, we are proud to announce the contents of the first expansion pack today.
It has been 9 months since Ostfront was released, and it’s been a fantastic experience for us to see the development - not only in our game, but also in our community. 
It’s time for the next step. 
So which nation will be added? We saw a lot of guessing, speculation and deducting going on in our Discord server lately, and this was great to watch. Some users came really close or guessed it right without knowing; anyhow, the wait is over!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1911520/Call_to_Arms__Gates_of_Hell_Talvisota/

[h1]Talvisota[/h1]
The second release will add Finland!
Three different conflicts took place in and around Finland between 1939 and 1945. 
“Talvisota” means winter war in Finnish. This was the first war for Finland since 1918, and we have recreated several of the greatest battles of the winter war. After that, the continuation war and the Lapland war made for some absolutely unique action, which we will depict as well.

Finland had its own equipment, from tanks to aircraft. Besides that, the Finnish army used a lot of captured equipment; they re- armed, modified and upgraded it and deployed it beside their own original equipment. This will be present in our game as well. 

Moreover, a lot of effort went into recreating Finnish landscapes, resulting in a set of beautiful new maps to a stunning degree of detail that give you the right feel and immersion connected to this part of the world. 
Talvisota gives you the Finnish faction, with an enormous collection of vehicles and weapons, a single player campaign and a plethora of new maps.

 Also, by popular demand, the classic skirmishes return. Built from the ground up in a new revolutionary format, these will propel the singleplayer segment of Call to Arms - Gates of Hell: Ostfront to a completely new level, as Talvisota will contain the skirmishes for all the nations in the game.

Development of Talvisota has been ongoing since September of last year. Progress has been steady and constant. We’re approaching the final stages of development, however we’re not ready to set a precise publication date yet.

Players who do not own Talvisota can still play against the Finnish faction and observe the capabilities and units of Talvisota so they can form an educated opinion before buying.[/b]

notes.title: The best Men of War: Assault Squad 2 mods
notes.content:
Men of War: Assault Squad 2 was released in 2014 but it still stands as an excellent tactical RTS game and war game, offering a layer of depth that's more granular than its common rival Company of Heroes. It's not that the damage system is more 'realistic', but the game's design is a bit more open-ended. You can summon in pre-set squads, or individual units to make and match your own fireteams.

There are also no 'bases' - you earn points at a steady rate throughout a match, and simply summon the units you want from a list. These new recruits will then appear at your friendly edge of the map. If you're looking for a more frantic and in depth WW2 tactical war game, there are few better and it's inspired a great mod community around it.

From Star Wars and 40k, WW1 to modern warfare, there's a creative and diverse selection of Men of War: Assault Squad 2 mods to give you something new to play around with. Many of them are focused on multiplayer, but there's a surprising amount of decent single-player or skirmish content around now as well.

notes.title: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 - Cold War released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/0363bc0f42f25340444d4a5d361c60dea4d7c3b5.jpg[/img]
Men of War: Assault Squad 2 – Cold War is available now!

Building upon the framework of Men of War: Assault Squad 2, Cold War introduces a brand-new feature to the series: dynamic campaign creation. Mirroring the ever-present feeling of dread that permeated the era, dynamic campaign creation ensures no two campaign experiences play out the same in single player and co-op. From randomized skirmishes to custom army compositions, players will be forced to think on their feet in the heat of battle.

Study each individual unit in detail up to their weaponry and individual skillsets. Scavenge enemy equipment and carry it over to the next battle. Build up experienced and combat proven squads, as each single soldier will move from one battle to another. Unlock new technology and evolve armies up to 5 times larger than the regular Assault Squad 2 multiplayer matches.


Join us in Discord to ask us questions and hang out in our release party channel!

[url=https://discord.gg/7MrUjcN][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/e72254b885a20b77e5ac5c49729d0742e84a231f.png[/img][/url]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/f5fe10914f3341b163c67c38e55ae16c1e583896.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Armor System[/h1]
You may notice that we introduced a new armor penetration system into the game. Don’t be scared of the healthbars, these aren’t typical ones, like you know from other games. In fact Men of War, used a sort of hidden armor health system and upon penetration of a tank, it was throwing a dice as of what is going to happen next for instance:
If you shot a tank and penetrated it, there was a 30% chance for hull crush and a 15% chance for hull broken and a certain chance for crew to die. This caused entire random results: if you hit a M24 tank, this could lead into a kill on first hit, or a kill on the 5th hit.

The new system works as follows: it gives each caliber a certain minimum damage it causes, as there is a difference between a 20mm and 120mm projectile. Then it uses the real penetration mechanics and depending on how hard you hit a tank, it will do more or less damage. This is to simulate that there is a difference between 1mm penetration and a shell just going through paper.

The new system allows accurate results each time, perfect for competitive gaming. It’s no less realistic than the old system, other than we visually display what’s happening to you. It also allows us to balance tanks in different ways, not just by armor thickness, but also by how big a tank is and how vulnerable it is. Use hardcore mode for a similar experience, you are used to in AS2.

[h1]New Netcode[/h1]
For the future, we have plans for an entirely new netcode. The game will move away from peer2peer networking and support real server2client. This means, out of syncs will be a thing of the past, as everything will be synced through a server. It also will be a huge gain on performance for clients. In the previous netcode each PC must do all the calculations, in the new netcode, server will do most of the work and clients have time for fast render speed. We will invite the first players to help us testing as soon as the beta version is ready and then we will gradually op

[h1]More to come![/h1]
And that’s not all! We will be presenting a lot of additional features soon. Check out every detail in the game, there is lots to discover. Some hints: you will see medics in multiplayer, as well as engineers with new construction options, oh and helicopters, as well as airstrikes in multiplayer (which will be expanded)!

[h1]Why so few maps?[/h1]
Please don’t be shocked by the amount of maps in-game, we moved away from having tons of little maps to massive maps that are split into several parts. Each gamemode and in fact, even the same gamemode, will randomize the spawn points and parts of the maps that are accessible to you. One Cold War map has the size of 4 of some of the largest AS2 maps.

notes.title: Presenting the Ostfront Veteranen!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/64e86a08a904344919ad591524ebaced1044efa2.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/920840/Men_of_War_Assault_Squad_2__Ostfront_Veteranen/]Men of War: Assault Squad 2 – Ostfront Veteranen[/url] is a new faction DLC and expands on the game with a new unit selection, unseen in the franchise so far. Join the battle as a new German faction with more than 10 new vehicles and experienced infantry squads, who earned their spurs on the toughest of all battlefields, the Eastern Front. The new faction will be available in multiplayer and player vs. AI matches.

Today we talk about the new faction in detail! For us, it was very important to bring some fresh air into the multiplayer matches with the new faction, hence we tried to get away from the typical mirror set-ups and make the new units play and feel differently. Below we name the most important new units and features.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/92750acc39107df536dfaa111092e197779cde46.jpg[/img]

[h1]Leichte Aufklärer[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/40ad0f8957cebcbb5ffabababee82ebd4d4c08ed.png[/img]
The light scouts are equipped with the K98, MP40 and StGw44. Unlike other factions, the Ostfront Veteranen have no T1 units. They make up for this, to have battle hardened and stronger T2 units, but they lack the numbers other factions have. Quality over quantity.

[h1]Stosstrupp[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/37a911e1a64ddf6b1bd99af64618395e3cd2c045.png[/img]
The stormtroopers use captured PPSh and SVT-40's, as well as the new MP41. They are an excellent choice, if you need to push for a strategic point. You will also notice, that they come with nice camo pattern, unseen in-game so far.

[h1]Veteranen[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/f271bb721c1d5e5ef40f83aac5d0c8380daa5042.png[/img]
The veterans earned their ranks on the Eastern European battlefields, and unlike the first German faction, they don't carry an MG42, but the older, yet reliable MG34. It doesn't have the same suppression power, like the MG42, but the 100 rounds and good accuracy provide long and excellent support fire.

[h1]Jäger[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/3328ba0993aac6ceac2efe952dafc4fc0ffd7d14.png[/img]
The Jäger infantery is an elite force of the German army. You will find them equipped with the new G41's, G43 scope and MG34 machine gun for support fire. Their auto rifle capacity and strong machine gun makes them a perfect match to allied elite infantry, especially U.S. We even took care of the little details and added their badge to their hats to identify them.

[h1]Gebirgsjäger[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/a0afe80e3eb34ae6cc5d664058adf456e574b3af.png[/img]
The elite mountain infantry is extremely well trained and battle hardened. They are tought to fight in snowy and cold environments, as well as to climb up mountains to fight their foes from advanced positions. You will enjoy them with the new scoped StGw44. The new weapon allows them to fight their enemies from greater distance with excellent accuracy. Together with the G41, their rate of fire and distance they can fight at, is superior to most t5 infantry in-game. Of course, they also come as mechanized infantry, with the all new SdKfz 250/1. A neat extra, Gebirgsjäger, use the German 3kg Ladung, instead of the common dynamite other factions have.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/73e81491c7492d3e8e57b0c5900d1f9b41eaf333.jpg[/img]

[h1]SdKfz 250/1[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/5a903fb5520ae0ee229857400619b7c2949e4108.png[/img]
The little brother of the SdKfz 251/1 can carry less personnel, but isn't that big of a target and offers more agility. In case of the Ostfront Veteranen, it gives you the option for mechanized Gebirgsjäger at a very affordable price, but keep in mind, you get less soldiers in exchange.

[h1]Stuka zu Fuß[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/e750392d0a49fa7f53aced8fdc3b328c5278f7f7.png[/img]
Literally translated, walking Stuka. The reference to the famous dive-bomber is a well chosen nickname based on the sound of rockets. The Stuka zu Fuß is extremely deadly, carrying large 280mm rockets that destroy everything in their path. Less rockets than the Panzerwerfer 40, but more powerful.

[h1]Grille[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/84c6227556b06998b0cba840e6fd159d790352eb.png[/img]
The "cricket" is armed with a 150mm howitzer and is the little brother of the Hummel "bumblebee". The Grille is based on the Czech 38(t), is very vulnerable, but a much smaller target than the Hummel.

[h1]SdKfz 234[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/6f35d9790be6114d13ccbaf183c7b84999be2d5e.png[/img]
Based on the same chassis as the Puma, the SdKfz 234 is armed with a rapid firing 20mm auto-cannon and is an extremely well choice to support your advancing infantry. The high speed makes it a perfect choice to harass your enemies on different locations.

[h1]SdKfz 7[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/4af13e3e28675e25be9083da2b0dbf60d2b41ecc.png[/img]
The SdKfz 7 is an armored truck meets 3.7cm FlaK. Powerful anti-infantry and light vehicle choice, but lacks any serious armor. The rapid fire of the FlaK helps you to engage multiple targets efficiently at a relatively low cost. Just make sure, they don't hit you first.

[h1]Hetzer[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/09e24e2fac86b7061875bf1a859f0858be17a505.png[/img]
The Hetzer, which refers to hunting someone down with dogs, is also based on the Czech 38(t) tank. Equipped with a strong 75mm gun, it can take out any medium tank facing it. The weak armor is compensated by the extremely flat angles of the armor plates. Just make sure, you are not hit by the sides or behind. It's an ambush tank and will perform best at his main role.

[h1]KfZ 15[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/12d341f044a56444b88686a78abe14fbb78c412d.png[/img]
The KfZ 15 is the new light car for the Ostfront Veteranen. If you call in anti-tank guns, they will come with the light gun carrier at some extra price. While you don't have the quantity of at-guns like other factions have, you have the most agile choices at your hand.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/3ad9ac2c7c9ae7c225f2749880c0494dc0aad706.jpg[/img]

[h1]Veteran Officer[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/62fac43fb8e1d3e12e63f5b31aec286b9ada770e.png[/img]
The Veteran Officer is tough, can take a lot of beating and is supported by elite infantry to guard him during his spotting mission. He's an excellent choice, if you need more intel on your enemies.

[h1]Panzerschreck Squad[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/f1f9128da5d7875090be197d600279797ed6639a.png[/img]
Unlike the base German faction, the Ostfront Veteranen have no access to the Panzerschreck. Their at-infantry comes with the limited range and new Panzerfaust 60. It's cost efficient but requires you to get close to your enemies. The slow speed of the projectile also makes it hard to hit moving targets. The Panzerschreck squad will help you deal with anything that a Panzerfaust 60 can't deal with.

[h1]SdKfz 234/3[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/0b5bcdf7bf17ac5c2f5ded917c736ae009d9fe19.png[/img]
Based on a common platform, this armored car offers a short barreled 75mm gun and can provide you fire support from a safe distance early on. It's fast and agile, but has no turret, so it is best used against stationary targets.

[h1]Strafbataillon[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/d0514f2a81ad13c273dd42a006124f40f33be7d0.png[/img]
The Strafbataillon consists of soldiers who were found guilty of misconduct. They were used to fight in the most dangerous missions and they were considered expendable. They are lightly equipped, but have enough Panzerfausts to do some serious damage, if anything comes close to them. One of their tactics in real life was, to let Soviet tanks drive over their trenches, to destroy them in a suicidal way.

[h1]Stosstrupp[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/c1efb41f642d26c2cf468fe0f6f9446cbca8179e.png[/img]
The Stosstrupp comes with a half-track, mounting Gebirgsjäger and a 28mm anti-tank gun. This little gun is doing well enough to protect your soldiers from armored cars and offers a great counter to auto-cannon armored cars that you might find along the way.

[h1]SdKfz 234/4[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/322941cd5854c211508821d88d429043d4f95f7e.png[/img]
The cousin of the Puma, equipped with a 75mm pak, this armored car can take out quite some well armored targets. However, no turret means it's hard to hunt down moving targets. It's a great ambush vehicle and can switch its positions quickly.

[h1]Radio Operator[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/b42ba690ce0afc7de9cda2266d669a5dad7d206e.png[/img]
Of course, the Radio Operator mustn't go missing for the Ostfront Veteranen either, so you will find it in your special units section, as well.

[h1]Beutepanzer T-34[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/9f63d11b4882caab29ae9584f14b31b310b4edac.png[/img]
Whenever the Germans could, they took conquered material and used them against their former owners. The Beutepanzer T-34 is such an example. Enjoy it with a special camo paint and support infantry guarding it.

[h1]SdKfz 8 Flak 37[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/45bf926a929f004192ff7f6aa7d27cfef659ad68.png[/img]
As if mounting a 37mm FlaK isn't enough, this armored truck comes with a 88mm FlaK mounted on it. A great anti-tank choice for a reasonable price.

[h1]Schweres Wurfgerät[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/f5a2e03383362e2b6e07ecc529a34d5bb3e4c7a2.png[/img]
The stationary sibling of the Stuka zu Fuß. Very powerful, very strong, but at a higher price than other stationary rocket launchers.

[h1]Brummbär[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/294057cfc95637c87afc757bf6330f8b6bc980b6.png[/img]
The Brummbär "grumbling bear" has a short barreled 150mm howitzer. It's not exactly accurate, but thanks to the extremely good front armor, you can drive in relatively closely to your enemies and who needs pin point accuracy with a 150mm explosive shell, anyways?

[h1]Jagdtiger[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1560170/cb88ccccea24805568d011e58ff8d448092024ef.png[/img]
The Jagdtiger "hunting tiger" is exactly what it names says. It's a tiger tank, for hunting down other tanks. The 128mm main gun makes this a beast of a tank killer. The frontal armor is almost impenetrable for most other tanks, but as with many tank destroyers, watch your tracks!

Stay tuned for more news and updates, we are eager to listen to your feedback!

notes.title: Update and new DLC
notes.content:
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/banner_01.jpg[/img]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/244450]Men of War: Assault Squad 2[/url] received a new update, solving many issues and adding new features to the game!

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/244450/discussions/0/540733523822983644/#c615085406673486818]Change-log[/url]!

[h1]Steam lobby chat[/h1]
You may have noticed that we introduced the Steam global chat into the game. It allows you to communicate within the game or through the Steam group chat with other players. For Deluxe Edition owners, we also introduced a set of new emoticons. ːhonorː

[h1]In-game friends list[/h1]
Additionally we introduced the in-game Steam friends list. You can see who of your friends is currently playing or who just created a game that you can join. One click is enough and you will team up with your friends!

[h1]Async texture loader[/h1]
To support modding and to enhance stability of long lasting custom games, we introduced a technology that limits the video RAM usage. The game won't go over that limit to prevent the usual instability you have with 32bit applications. It's one of the features that we have been investing a lot of resources into, so that we can improve the quality and stability of the game!

[h1]Session filters[/h1]
You also received new session filters that allow you to choose what kind of games you are really looking for. Since Steam sessions support 50 results only, it's even more important to make sure that the results you get really matter to you.

[img]http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/357760/ss_66a9388e4039056f05cff8599c9f4a0522d787b0.1920x1080.jpg?t=1433446550&alt_url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/357760/ss_66a9388e4039056f05cff8599c9f4a0522d787b0.1920x1080.jpg?t=1433446551[/img]

[h1]Men of War: Assault Squad - Airborne[/h1]

We listened to your feedback and we spent many months working hard to finally introduce multiplayer bots to the Men of War series for the very first time. As owner of the new DLC you will be able to host games and set bots in up to four difficulty modes in matches as large as 8v8. In custom games only the host requires to own the DLC to add bots to either team, everyone else can still join and play as usual.

To make things even more interesting, you receive the functionality to play match-making vs. bots to collect XP and statistics on your performance!

The community also requested more singleplayer style missions and we came up with a combination of Stealth and Airborne missions. For those of you who want to drop right into the heavy action, you can skip the Stealth part thanks to the new mission options.

These mission options have been added to original missions as well, so you may want to try them out again. Especially the tank DLC missions, which feature several tanks to choose from now!

Owners of the Deluxe Edition receive a limited time 20% discount!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/357760

notes.title: Game update 3.112.0
notes.content:
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/banner_07.jpg[/img]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/244450]Men of War: Assault Squad 2[/url] received it's largest update so far!

We have been working hard to deliver you new and exciting features. Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/244450/discussions/0/540733523822983644/#c620700960625514705]change-log[/url] and read more about the most important changes below.


[h1] Veterancy [/h1]
Each individual soldier collects XP and levels up during combat. Vehicles do not gain XP but the crew inside does. The more advanced your soldiers are, the better they get at handling weapons and vehicles. They will also get stronger and more resilient to enemy fire. Taking care of your soldiers and saving your tank crew is more important than ever before.
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_17.jpg[/img]

[h1] Vehicle Skills [/h1]
Your soldiers have different vehicle skills now. Tank crew are experts at driving and shooting tanks, while ground troops are better at handling artillery. It's now a key to success to use the right type of infantry instead of the cheapest. But don't worry, your crew efficiency is being displayed in the interface, so you will learn quickly which infantry is the best one to pick.

[h1] Stamina [/h1]
We have been reworking the Stamina system to reflect veterancy of units and differ elite infantry from regular infantry even more. You can now see how fast your Stamina regenerates and how much Stamina each soldier has, the same goes for Health.
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_19.jpg[/img]

[h1] Custom Units [/h1]
We introduced a new multiplayer selection. The host can now pick between different groups of units and design his own multiplayer mode by including or excluding certain type of units. Together with a great amount of MP and CP options, there is a huge amount of varation to choose from. You may also alter the charge timers of all units to finetune your own gamemode even more.
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_18.jpg[/img]

[h1] Spectators [/h1]
Replays will be part of our next DLC, however you will get access to spectators as a free feature in the next update. Hosts can determine whether they want spectators or not. Spectators do not influence the resource distribution or other balance mechanics.

[h1] Interface Improvements [/h1]
A new event log that helps you to keep track of what's going on has been introduced. If you missed out on an event, don't worry you can open the event history log and read up all events. Also, you will get notified of important events during the game, like whether your team is winning or losing.

[h1] Tutorials [/h1]
We also introduced in-game video tutorials. You will be able to select a variety of videos that show you the best tips and tricks. Special thanks to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197971266926/]strat29[/url] & [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/judska/]Judska[/url] for voicing these.
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_14.jpg[/img][img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_15.jpg[/img]

[h1] Auto re-supplying of units [/h1]
Ammo trucks and ammo boxes will now auto supply your units if they are close enough and turn into new strategic objectives. They will however only refill basic ammunition. You will still have to scavenge the battlefield to collect grenades, dynamite and other useful tools. None the less, you will easily re-arm dozens of riflemen and machine gunners in one go. Especially if an officer is amongst your troops, who can call in ammo para drops.
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_16.jpg[/img]



[h1][b]Known issues:[/b][/h1]
Steam overlay does not work properly with the game for some people. If you encounter freezes, please deactive Steam overlay for AS2.

To do so, go to your Steam library, right mouse click on AS2, select properties and disable Steam overlay.


Since this is a major graphics engine upgrade, there might be some unexpected issues that you encounter. In such cases try to run the safe mode and read this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/244450/discussions/0/611698195168187430/]topic[/url]. Please provide your feedback in this topic as well.

We will release some further patches soon.


Thanks and happy gaming! ːhonorː

notes.title: Game update 3.037.0
notes.content:
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/banner_09.jpg[/img]

We just released a new update for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/244450]Men of War: Assault Squad 2[/url].

The patch comes with plenty of new features, including a new game result screen, improvements to match-making and the netcode, as well as a new singleplayer menu interface supporting custom missions and achievements. The Commonwealth faction gets new units also! Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/244450/discussions/0/540733523822983644/#c41973820774981973]Change-Log[/url].


The Game Statistics screen will give you access to valuable information about your last online match. The Unit tab for instance will display the purchase log of every player, be it friend or foe. This way you can study the strategy of your teammates/opponents and how wisely they spent their resources!

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_10.jpg[/img]


Personal statistics on the other hand help you to understand which units performed the best and how much XP and ranked score you collected during your last match.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_11.jpg[/img]


We also improved the Player Profile screen and added a new tab called Compare. This tab will allow you to compare yourself with friends or to study the leaderboard and to compare yourself with others on one screen. 

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_06.jpg[/img]


We have also been re-designing the singleplayer menu. Now you can select all missions right off the start and the game will show you a preview of each mission as well as your achievements progress. To improve mod support and small screen resolutions, the mission list has now a scrolling functionality.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_07.jpg[/img]


To further improve mod support, we have also been re-designing the Workshop tab to make it easier for you to subscribe and manage mods. The game does not even need a restart to apply mods you have just finished downloading.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_08.jpg[/img]


Performance improvements have also been done in regards of the shadows with the help of Intel. We also added an ultra shadow setting to get the most out of high end hardware.

[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/update_09.jpg[/img]


Expect more features to be released soon, happy gaming and thanks for your support! ːhonorː

notes.title: Upgrades Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]http://www.digitalmindsoft.eu/outcoming/webimages/steam/banner_03.jpg[/img]

First off, thanks a lot for the amazing launch, today we peaked at more than [b]1800 concurrent players[/b]! It really means a lot to an independent developer like us. We are eagerly improving the game and we will add more features for you to try out soon!

To give you an idea about our biggest plans to upgrade the game, we decided to share a roadmap of key features with you. Keep in mind, this is all subject to change as we move ahead.

[h1]Shader technology improvements[/h1]
In our latest update, we fixed some serious issues related to the caching of shaders that were responsible for most of the stuttering. You will still experience some moderate stuttering the first time you run the game, but the more often you play the smoother the game gets. In the future we will offer two solutions, one is to add pre-cached shaders to the game so your PC doesn’t have to do all the work on the fly and secondly we will provide an improved background shader compiler that will increase the performance while new shaders are cached by the game. In any case, you will notice a huge improvement since the last update and we will continue to work on better performance and should be able to deliver you some results this month.

[h1]New resource manager[/h1]
For several months now, we have been working on a new resource manager that will further increase performance and will help us to introduce features that make the whole gaming experience more fluid. It will also help to make better use of the memory allocated to the game. We expect it to be finished sometime next month.

[h1]Netcode[/h1]
The netcode was giving us a major headache as it wasn’t compatible with the multi-threaded engine and wouldn’t work in large team games at all. We lost a month trying to solve this issue and we are finally at a point where the netcode runs fine. However, it’s not perfect yet and we will continue to improve it. Once it matches our standards we will unlock large player games beyond 4v4 again.

[h1]Match-making / lobby[/h1]
Currently Steamworks allows us to display 50 sessions only. So while the multiplayer looks rather unpopular, it’s absolutely not. We will think about a few solutions for this, as we want to make sure that the multiplayer lobby represents the real online activity. In case of match-making we are planning to do several improvements to the searching for players screen that will help you determine which nations and gamemodes are popular. We will also discuss the best options to display your online statistics such as victories per faction. On top of that we plan to add more statistics to track details such as the amount of units you destroyed and your K/D ratio.

[h1]DirectX 10[/h1]
Once we have done improvements to the netcode and match-making we will start to convert the game to DX10. DX9c will no longer be supported from that point on, but since we don’t support WindowsXP, it shouldn’t really affect anyone negatively. Instead DX10 will be another source for improvements to the game and engine and we hope to have it ready in around 2 months.

[h1]64bit[/h1]
Thanks to the help of the community we were able to solve an issue that prevented the game from using more memory from 64bit OS than the limit of 2048mb. This increased the stability of the game dramatically, as AS2, contrary to AS1 was slightly jumping over this barrier. None the less, 64bit will be a must to further increase the graphics fidelity and simultaneous units and objects displayed in-game. We will keep a 32bit client for those who do not run a 64bit OS, but graphic options will be limited. This feature should be available later this year.

[h1]DLC[/h1]
1C and we ourselves at Digitalmindsoft are convinced of a great future for AS2 so we agreed on the development of DLC for the game. These DLC will add more content and unique features to the game next to the free upgrades you are going to receive. We will talk about them when development progressed, but be assured, exciting times are ahead!

So stay tuned for more news coming soon and happy gaming!

notes.title: Open Beta - developer opinion!
notes.content:
We want to share some thoughts with you about the beta and the plans we have for the upcoming weeks. In this regard, I want to thank everyone who takes part in the beta and helps us providing a better game.

We have done some significant progress since Closed Beta, yet there are still issues that need to be solved. You might have noticed that the bug fixing lost a little bit of pace in the last 1-2 weeks. This is due to the fact that we were entirely reworking the internal error log system to support structured exception handling, which allows us to create minidumps of your crashes for much easier and faster bug fixing. On top of that we also support Steamworks Error Reporting that anonymously and automatically stores and uploads minidumps when a crash occurs. Even if no minidump was created, we still get a report every time a user crashes. This way we can clearly identify the biggest and most common issues and solve them more rapidly in the future, including rather rare issues.

Why have we experienced so many issues in first place? This is because many core aspects of the engine have been changed or updated to fit modern hardware requirements and technology. While the game looks similar to other MoW games, the backend is very different. Multi-core support, updated shader model, updated material rendering, Steamworks and many more things were admittedly too ambitious for the time we had. None the less, we think those changes were important as you deserve to finally get a serious engine upgrade. These improvements might not show off right now, but they definitely will be in the future.


We are rather pleased with the Singleplayer component, but the Multiplayer is undoubtedly not good enough, especially not the performance. Here we are working on a new thread manager to get the Multiplayer performance to a similar level like you have in Singleplayer. We should be able to present it to you later next week. We are also working on a new background resource loading/managing system which affects many parts of the engine and therefore it takes a while to complete. It should enable us to make better use of the new graphics features without such a hit on performance.

Also we have plans to update to DirectX10 and 64bit after the game has been released, which will allow us to further improve performance and stability. We also consider OpenGL and controller support for SteamOS. While quite likely, these are all subject to change.


Lastly, we will release the game when it reaches the quality standards we have. Should we need to further postpone the game, we will provide you additional content for the beta to make the waiting shorter. Again, we want to thank you for your support and we are working very hard to provide you the best possible Men of War experience to date! :)

notes.title: Open Beta - developer opinion!
notes.content:
We want to share some thoughts with you about the beta and the plans we have for the upcoming weeks. In this regard, I want to thank everyone who takes part in the beta and helps us providing a better game.

We have done some significant progress since Closed Beta, yet there are still issues that need to be solved. You might have noticed that the bug fixing lost a little bit of pace in the last 1-2 weeks. This is due to the fact that we were entirely reworking the internal error log system to support structured exception handling, which allows us to create minidumps of your crashes for much easier and faster bug fixing. On top of that we also support Steamworks Error Reporting that anonymously and automatically stores and uploads minidumps when a crash occurs. Even if no minidump was created, we still get a report every time a user crashes. This way we can clearly identify the biggest and most common issues and solve them more rapidly in the future, including rather rare issues.

Why have we experienced so many issues in first place? This is because many core aspects of the engine have been changed or updated to fit modern hardware requirements and technology. While the game looks similar to other MoW games, the backend is very different. Multi-core support, updated shader model, updated material rendering, Steamworks and many more things were admittedly too ambitious for the time we had. None the less, we think those changes were important as you deserve to finally get a serious engine upgrade. These improvements might not show off right now, but they definitely will be in the future.


We are rather pleased with the Singleplayer component, but the Multiplayer is undoubtedly not good enough, especially not the performance. Here we are working on a new thread manager to get the Multiplayer performance to a similar level like you have in Singleplayer. We should be able to present it to you later next week. We are also working on a new background resource loading/managing system which affects many parts of the engine and therefore it takes a while to complete. It should enable us to make better use of the new graphics features without such a hit on performance.

Also we have plans to update to DirectX10 and 64bit after the game has been released, which will allow us to further improve performance and stability. We also consider OpenGL and controller support for SteamOS. While quite likely, these are all subject to change.


Lastly, we will release the game when it reaches the quality standards we have. Should we need to further postpone the game, we will provide you additional content for the beta to make the waiting shorter. Again, we want to thank you for your support and we are working very hard to provide you the best possible Men of War experience to date! :)
